name: Bearing Bad Fruit
overview: Scripture teaches that true believers are identified by the fruit they bear, as Jesus warns against false prophets who appear harmless but are inwardly destructive, likened to wolves in sheep's clothing. Genuine spiritual life, rooted in Christ the true vine, produces good fruit, while corrupt trees yield bad fruit, revealing the works of the flesh such as adultery and uncleanness. In contrast, the fruit of the Spirit—love, joy, peace, and goodness—marks those abiding in Christ, underscoring the vital connection between a believer's character and their spiritual source.
